# Hongjin He (HongJin HE, 何泓錦)

> HKUST undergraduate (Risk Management & Business Intelligence, Mathematics minor, Extended Major in AI) researching world models, reinforcement learning and quantitative finance. Co-Founder & CTO of AlphaFlow (MicroWorld).

## Publications
- Hongjin He. "From Sharpe Ratios to Executable Evidence: A Reproducibility Case Study of a Financial DRL Ensemble." SSRN 7665158 (2026): https://papers.ssrn.com/abstract=7665158. Under review at TMLR.
- Hongjin He. "Sharp Ranking Bounds for Frozen Binary Forecasts with Unresolved Outcomes." Under review at Journal of Forecasting.
